description: A small white, cup-like cover sits on a white base in front of a large dark-blue pillow on a green-covered bed. The left hand slides in from the left to steady the base while the right hand approaches from the right, grips the cover as a right-hand object, lifts it straight up to separate it from the base, then moves it to the right and sets it down, leaving the base exposed in the center as the left hand releases.
